ID.citation: Idaho Big Game 2026 Seasons and Rules, p. 95
ID.detail: The half-hour-before-sunrise to half-hour-after-sunset rule is certified. Exact clock times remain unavailable because point-level Idaho timezone resolution is not certified.

MT.citation: 2026 Montana Upland Game Bird Hunting Regulations, p. 4
MT.detail: Exact point times are calculated from the certified half-hour-before-sunrise to half-hour-after-sunset rule.
